"""models/alexnet.py
=============================================================================
AlexNet model definition for the reproduction of
"Using Deep Learning for Image-Based Plant Disease Detection".

FR-04: the model must accept the pre-processed images (256 x 256 RGB tensors)
and output one logit per class (38 classes in the adapted AlexNet, i.e. the
final fully connected layer fc8 has 38 outputs).

Design constraints respected by this file
-----------------------------------------
* The architecture is *exactly* ``torchvision.models.AlexNet`` (5 conv layers,
  3 fully connected layers, ReLU after the first 7 layers, LRN / pooling after
  conv1 & conv2, pooling after conv5, dropout p=0.5 inside the classifier).
  The class simply inherits from the torchvision implementation so that the
  ImageNet pre-trained weights can be loaded 1:1 without any shape mismatch
  (transfer learning is handled by ``training/train.py::initialize_model``).
* No extra layers are added on top of the torchvision structure.
* The model class only defines the structure (randomly initialised).  Weight
  initialisation / pre-trained loading / ``training_mode`` (scratch|transfer)
  logic lives in ``training/train.py`` and is NOT done here.
* ``num_classes`` and ``dropout`` are read from ``config/config.yaml``
  (``model.num_classes``, ``model.alexnet.dropout_ratio`` / ``model.dropout_ratio``
  / ``training.dropout_ratio``).  Hard-coded values are used ONLY as a last
  resort fallback when the key is missing or null in the config file; the
  fallback values are derived from the paper (38 classes, dropout 0.5) and are
  documented below.
=============================================================================
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional, Union

import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
import yaml
from torch import nn
from torchvision.models import AlexNet as _TorchvisionAlexNet

__all__ = ["Alexnet", "load_config", "DEFAULT_NUM_CLASSES", "DEFAULT_DROPOUT"]

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Last-resort fallback defaults (only used when config/config.yaml is missing
# or the relevant key is null).  Source of these values = the paper:
#   * num_classes : 38 -> 14 crop species x 26 diseases / healthy status
#                   (fc8 of the adapted AlexNet has 38 outputs).
#   * dropout     : 0.5 -> dropout rate described in the paper
#                   (``model.alexnet.dropout_ratio`` / ``training.dropout_ratio``).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
DEFAULT_NUM_CLASSES = 38
DEFAULT_DROPOUT = 0.5

# Expected image input (RGB, 3 channels, 256 x 256 as per config['data']).
DEFAULT_IN_CHANNELS = 3

_DEFAULT_CONFIG_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "config" / "config.yaml"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Config helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def load_config(config_path: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Load ``config/config.yaml`` (UTF-8) and return it as a dictionary.

    If the file does not exist an empty dictionary is returned so that the
    module keeps working with the documented paper defaults.
    """
    path = Path(config_path) if config_path is not None else _DEFAULT_CONFIG_PATH
    if not path.is_file():
        logger.warning("config file not found at %s; falling back to paper defaults", path)
        return {}
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        cfg = yaml.safe_load(fh)
    return cfg if isinstance(cfg, dict) else {}


def _resolve_config(
    config: Optional[Union[str, Path, Dict[str, Any]]],
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Accept a dict, a path or ``None`` and always return a config dictionary."""
    if config is None:
        return load_config()
    if isinstance(config, dict):
        return config
    return load_config(config)


def _nested_get(cfg: Dict[str, Any], *keys: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:
    """Safely walk nested dictionaries; return ``default`` on missing/null keys."""
    node: Any = cfg
    for key in keys:
        if not isinstance(node, dict) or key not in node:
            return default
        node = node[key]
    return default if node is None else node


def _resolve_value(arg_value: Any, cfg_value: Any, default: Any) -> Any:
    """Priority: explicit argument > config value > documented fallback."""
    if arg_value is not None:
        return arg_value
    if cfg_value is not None:
        return cfg_value
    return default


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Alexnet(_TorchvisionAlexNet):
    """AlexNet adapted for image-based plant disease detection.

    Structure (identical to ``torchvision.models.AlexNet``):
        * 5 convolutional layers (conv1..conv5); conv1/conv2 are followed by a
          normalisation (Local Response Normalisation) and a max-pooling layer,
          conv3/conv4 have no pooling, conv5 is followed by a pooling layer;
        * 3 fully connected layers (fc6, fc7, fc8) with ReLU after fc6 and fc7
          and dropout (p = 0.5) before fc6 and fc7;
        * fc8 outputs one raw logit per class (38 in the adapted version).

    The forward pass returns raw logits; softmax cross-entropy
    (``torch.nn.CrossEntropyLoss``) is applied by the training loop.

    Parameters
    ----------
    num_classes:
        Number of output classes.  ``None`` (default) means "read it from
        ``config/config.yaml`` -> ``model.num_classes``"; if that key is missing
        or null the paper default (38) is used.  A concrete positive integer is
        always handed to ``nn.Linear`` (never ``None``).
    dropout:
        Dropout probability used inside the classifier.  ``None`` (default)
        means "read it from ``model.alexnet.dropout_ratio`` (fallbacks:
        ``model.dropout_ratio``, ``training.dropout_ratio``)"; if missing/null
        the paper default (0.5) is used.
    config:
        Optional config dictionary, or a path to a YAML file.  When ``None``
        the project config ``config/config.yaml`` is loaded automatically.

    Notes
    -----
    * This class ONLY defines the architecture (random initialisation).  It does
      not contain any ``training_mode`` branch and never loads a state dict;
      pre-trained ImageNet weights / ``classifier.6`` reset are handled in
      ``training/train.py::initialize_model`` (FR-06).
    * No layers are added or removed with respect to the torchvision model, so
      ImageNet pre-trained weights can be loaded with ``strict=True`` after the
      final layer has been replaced (``classifier.6`` -> 38 outputs).
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        num_classes: Optional[int] = None,
        dropout: Optional[float] = None,
        config: Optional[Union[str, Path, Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
    ) -> None:
        cfg = _resolve_config(config)

        # ---- shape parameters from config/config.yaml (with safe fallbacks) ----
        cfg_num_classes = _nested_get(cfg, "model", "num_classes")
        cfg_dropout = _nested_get(cfg, "model", "alexnet", "dropout_ratio")
        if cfg_dropout is None:
            cfg_dropout = _nested_get(cfg, "model", "dropout_ratio")
        if cfg_dropout is None:
            cfg_dropout = _nested_get(cfg, "training", "dropout_ratio")

        resolved_num_classes = int(
            _resolve_value(num_classes, cfg_num_classes, DEFAULT_NUM_CLASSES)
        )
        resolved_dropout = float(_resolve_value(dropout, cfg_dropout, DEFAULT_DROPOUT))

        # ---- sanity checks (never hand None / invalid values to nn.Linear) ----
        if resolved_num_classes <= 0:
            logger.warning(
                "invalid num_classes=%s; falling back to %d",
                resolved_num_classes,
                DEFAULT_NUM_CLASSES,
            )
            resolved_num_classes = int(DEFAULT_NUM_CLASSES)
        if not (0.0 <= resolved_dropout < 1.0):
            logger.warning(
                "invalid dropout=%s; falling back to %s",
                resolved_dropout,
                DEFAULT_DROPOUT,
            )
            resolved_dropout = float(DEFAULT_DROPOUT)

        # ---- build the torchvision AlexNet structure ----
        try:
            super().__init__(num_classes=resolved_num_classes, dropout=resolved_dropout)
        except TypeError:
            # Very old torchvision versions without the `dropout` argument.
            super().__init__(num_classes=resolved_num_classes)
            for module in self.modules():
                if isinstance(module, nn.Dropout):
                    module.p = resolved_dropout

        # Plain metadata attributes (not layers) kept for convenience/logging.
        self.num_classes = resolved_num_classes
        self.dropout = resolved_dropout

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        """Forward pass: features -> (avgpool) -> flatten -> classifier.

        Parameters
        ----------
        x:
            Input batch of pre-processed images, shape ``(N, C, H, W)`` with
            ``C = 3`` and ``H = W = 256`` (see ``config['data']``).

        Returns
        -------
        torch.Tensor
            Raw logits of shape ``(N, num_classes)`` (38 by default).
        """
        if x.dim() != 4:
            raise ValueError(
                "Alexnet.forward expects a 4-D tensor (N, C, H, W), got shape "
                f"{tuple(x.shape)}"
            )

        x = self.features(x)

        if hasattr(self, "avgpool") and self.avgpool is not None:
            x = self.avgpool(x)
        else:  # pragma: no cover - only for very old torchvision builds
            x = F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(x, (6, 6))

        x = torch.flatten(x, 1)
        x = self.classifier(x)
        return x


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Smoke test (FR-04 acceptance: instantiation + forward pass)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if __name__ == "__main__":  # pragma: no cover
    model = Alexnet()
    dummy = torch.randn(2, DEFAULT_IN_CHANNELS, 256, 256)
    output = model(dummy)
    assert output.shape == (2, model.num_classes), output.shape
    n_params = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())
    print(f"Alexnet forward OK -> output shape {tuple(output.shape)}, "
          f"num_classes={model.num_classes}, dropout={model.dropout}, "
          f"parameters={n_params}")
</parameter>
</invoke>
</antml>
</output>
